extras.textures: PBR 2048px: base color, roughness, metallic, normal (baked)
extras.real_size: pair of cowboy spurs, each about 16 cm long and 10 cm wide
extras.notes: steel heel bands with brass buttons, short shank with fork and a fixed brass rowel with twelve blunt rounded points (part of the main mesh, not a separate wheel), wide leather straps with stitching, concho and buckle. Both spurs lie on the ground, rowels point to +Y

origin.detail: Built procedurally with Blender scripts. The scripts were written with the help of an AI coding assistant. No generative AI model produced the geometry or textures directly.
